experiment_data.hypothesis: Contamination dose-response: 在 10%/30%/50% synthetic injection 比例下，graduated filtering 相对 binary filtering 的收益是否随 contamination 增加而扩大？验证 C3 (graduated filtering superiority) 在不同 contamination severity 下的 robustness。3 ratios × 3 strategies (no-filter/binary/graduated) × 5 seeds, continued pretraining Qwen2.5-1.5B, eval MMLU+HellaSwag.

metrics.cross_ratio_finding: Binary filtering consistently best across all ratios. Graduated filtering = no_filter at every ratio. Effect size of binary advantage increases with contamination ratio (HellaSwag delta: 10%=+0.38pp, 30%=+0.61pp, 50%=+0.51pp). Original C3 hypothesis (graduated > binary) rejected.
